# Songbook Lite

> Your mixing desks' show files, in a browser tab: inspect, document, convert, write back

A desktop show-file library for digital mixing desks: Allen & Heath SQ, dLive and Avantis, and Yamaha CL/QL, TF, DM3 and DM7. Every show is kept with a version history and the vendor file it came from. You can look at and edit the I/O and patch, the channels, the sends, the buses, the DCAs and mute groups and the scenes. It writes PDF documentation, an input-list CSV, printable label strips and Bitfocus Companion pages; it converts a show between desks with a report of what carried over, what was adapted and what was dropped; it writes SQ shows and CL/QL files back with their checksums intact; and it pulls from and pushes to the live desk over MIDI/TCP or SCP. Songbook Lite runs the same in a browser tab.

It's a Stoatworks Labs web tool: free, and it runs in a web browser.
